description: Space Exploration covers why we explore space, the pioneers who led the way, building and launching a model rocket, the science of rockets and orbits, robotic and crewed missions, spacecraft and the International Space Station, and designing a base on another world.

safety.note: Launch model rockets only with adult supervision, following the National Association of Rocketry safety code and local laws.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. The excerpts ended before requirement 8 (careers), which is not outlined yet. Model rockets must follow National Association of Rocketry safety rules; an alternate is available where launches are not allowed.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Why we explore
requirements.summary: The reasons for space exploration, its goals and its benefits on Earth.

requirements.title: Space pioneers
requirements.summary: A collector’s card about a space pioneer, and discussing several others.

requirements.title: A model rocket
requirements.summary: Building, launching and recovering a model rocket, or the alternate where launches are not allowed.

requirements.title: Rocket and space science
requirements.summary: Action and reaction, rocket engines, orbits and how spacecraft communicate.

requirements.title: Missions
requirements.summary: Two options on robotic and crewed missions, a current mission, or designing a sample-return mission.

requirements.title: Spacecraft
requirements.summary: The purpose and parts of a crewed orbital vehicle or the International Space Station.

requirements.title: A space base
requirements.summary: Designing an inhabited base and how it would provide energy, shelter and life support.
